propositions: GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name fields only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup
The session-start readiness gate waits for Epic fields before any project exists, creating a deadlock where the gate blocks the action that would provision those fields
Experiment 30981084637 proved the ordering deadlock: 180 seconds of idle time produced no change in field inventory, but project creation provisioned Epic fields in 0.05 seconds
The fix relocates the Epic-field check from session-start wait_for_jira_dc_ready to _assert_project_capabilities which runs after project creation, breaking the deadlock
The decision rule in not_ready_message claiming 'no customfield_* entries means plugin is still starting' is wrong and self-confirming for instances with no projects
Run 30982731669 harness verification: 62 passed, 1 xfailed, 0 failed, 0 errored, with measurement range 0.032s-0.058s corroborating the 120s allowance derived from 0.0512s baseline
